Actions.Title: Join Zoom
Actions.Description: Join a Zoom meeting through the embedded Meeting SDK.

Actions.Title: Leave Zoom
Actions.Description: Leave the current embedded Zoom meeting.

Actions.Title: Fade to Black
Actions.Description: Fade Program video to black or back in over 300 ms. Audio and output sessions continue.

Actions.Title: Set Fade to Black
Actions.Description: Set Program blackout; repeated identical requests do not reverse the fade.

Actions.Title: Take
Actions.Description: Cut/transition Preview to Program.

Actions.Title: Set transition
Actions.Description: Set the Take transition (cut/fade/dip/wipe).

Actions.Title: Record toggle
Actions.Description: Toggle recording.

Actions.Title: Record set
Actions.Description: Start or stop recording explicitly.

Actions.Title: Stream toggle
Actions.Description: Toggle streaming.

Actions.Title: Stream set
Actions.Description: Start or stop streaming explicitly.

Actions.Title: Configure RTMP destination
Actions.Description: Save RTMP/RTMPS settings without starting streaming. Refused while streaming or transitioning; omitted key retains the saved key, empty clears it.

Actions.Title: Configure SRT destination
Actions.Description: Save SRT settings without starting streaming. Refused while streaming or transitioning; omitted passphrase retains it, empty clears it.

Actions.Title: NDI toggle
Actions.Description: Toggle NDI output. Independent of streaming; refused (and left off) when the NDI settings are invalid.

Actions.Title: NDI set
Actions.Description: Turn NDI output on or off explicitly. Independent of streaming; turning on is refused (and NDI left off) when the NDI settings are invalid.

Actions.Title: NDI graphics key
Actions.Description: Turn the NDI graphics key (fill+key: on-air graphics only, BGRA with straight alpha) on or off. It rides with NDI output; omitted name keeps the current one, empty uses "<NDI program name> Graphics".

Params.Name: name
Params.Description: NDI source name for the key

Actions.Title: Engine toggle
Actions.Description: Toggle the capture engine on/off.

Actions.Title: Engine set
Actions.Description: Turn the capture engine on or off explicitly.

Actions.Title: Virtual camera toggle
Actions.Description: Toggle the virtual camera output.

Actions.Title: Virtual camera set
Actions.Description: Turn the virtual camera on or off explicitly.

Actions.Title: Virtual camera mirror
Actions.Description: Mirror the virtual camera output horizontally.

Actions.Title: Virtual camera name
Actions.Description: Set the virtual camera's display name (blank keeps the default).

Actions.Title: Select scene
Actions.Description: Cue a scene to Preview by id. Unknown scene fails and changes nothing; reply includes previewSceneId when applied.

Actions.Title: Cue scene with routes
Actions.Description: Cue a scene to Preview and point named routes at Show Input slots. JSON object: routeId → slot number or null (empty box). Unknown scene, route or slot fails and changes nothing. Reply includes previewSceneId when applied.

Actions.Title: Set scene route
Actions.Description: Cue a scene to Preview and point one named route at a Show Input slot. Unknown scene, route or slot fails and changes nothing. Reply includes previewSceneId when applied.

Params.Name: routeId
Params.Description: Route id on that scene (for example ohg-host)

Actions.Title: List scenes
Actions.Description: Read the scene rail (id, name, layout; hidden multiview-solo scenes excluded) with previewSceneId and activeSceneId. Changes nothing; reply carries data. Catalog scenes can be removed (#1070), so check here before cueing one by id.

Actions.Title: Restore starter scenes
Actions.Description: Re-add any removed catalog scene (intro, interview, speaker-slides, panel, closing) at its catalog position with fresh starter routes. Existing scenes, Program and Preview are untouched.

Actions.Title: Create CoreVideo Tiles
Actions.Description: Create a dynamic CoreVideo Tiles scene and cue it to Preview.

Actions.Title: Tiles automatic fill
Actions.Description: Set automatic roster fill for the Tiles scene in Preview.

Actions.Title: Assign Tiles slot
Actions.Description: Assign a canonical source id to a Preview Tiles slot; blank source clears the assignment.

Actions.Title: Tiles never show
Actions.Description: Exclude or allow a canonical source id in the Preview Tiles scene.

Actions.Title: Tiles background
Actions.Description: Set Preview Tiles color and optional live source. Scene media background remains available beneath it.

Actions.Title: Pin and crop tile
Actions.Description: Pin a Preview tile rectangle (0-1), set left/right crop percentages and order (0-63). Other tiles fill the largest remaining rectangle.

Actions.Title: Clear tile override
Actions.Description: Return a Preview tile to automatic grid positioning and crop.

Actions.Title: Tiles name each tile
Actions.Description: Show one name line (the source's lower-third name, top line only) inside each Preview Tiles member tile, in the scene's lower-third style. Tiles too small for a readable line stay unlabelled.

Actions.Title: Set view mode
Actions.Description: Set the operator view (program/preview/program-preview/multiview); programPreview is accepted as a legacy alias.

Actions.Title: Load Volt clip
Actions.Description: Refresh the local media bin and return the staged clip's source id.

Actions.Title: Preview Volt clip
Actions.Description: Cue a staged clip to a named scene route on Preview.

Params.Name: route
Params.Description: Route id; optional in a scene with one eligible route

Actions.Title: Take Volt clip
Actions.Description: Take the specified staged clip when it is still on Preview.

Params.Name: route
Params.Description: Route id; optional in a scene with one eligible route

Actions.Title: Assign input
Actions.Description: Assign a source to a Show Input slot (1-10).

Actions.Title: Connect or take capture offline
Actions.Description: Use the existing capture device controls. Taking a device offline unassigns its inputs; native video readiness remains separately observed.

Actions.Title: Unassign show input
Actions.Description: Clear only this input through the same operator command; the source remains available for reassignment.

Actions.Title: Name input source
Actions.Description: Set the display name override for a Show Input's source (blank resets).

Actions.Title: Source on dropout
Actions.Description: Set what a source shows when it stops delivering (hold last frame or black). Zoom-only this slice.

Actions.Title: Input in-show
Actions.Description: Add/remove a Show Input slot from the show.

Actions.Title: Lower-third toggle
Actions.Description: Toggle the program lower-third.

Actions.Title: Lower-third set
Actions.Description: Show or hide the program lower-third explicitly.

Actions.Title: Set caption
Actions.Description: Set the caption text (and optional speaker).

Actions.Title: Toggle graphic
Actions.Description: Toggle a graphic/overlay by id.

Actions.Title: Configure graphics rules
Actions.Description: Save scoped native graphics rules without arming them.

Actions.Title: Control graphics automation
Actions.Description: Select mode, arm/disarm, hold, resume or hide automatic graphics.

Actions.Title: Select graphics authority
Actions.Description: Explicitly select the legacy or instance authority for a migrated family.

Actions.Title: Create graphic instance
Actions.Description: Create a hidden native graphic; admission is separate from preparation.

Actions.Title: Update graphic instance
Actions.Description: Prepare a cue or explicitly update Program without replaying the reveal.

Actions.Title: Cue graphic instance
Actions.Description: Prepare the accepted revision for Preview without changing Program.

Actions.Title: Trigger graphic instance
Actions.Description: Show after readiness, hide or clear a revision, or pause, resume or restart a Program crawl.

Actions.Title: Control graphics clock
Actions.Description: Configure, start, pause, resume or reset the native clock without showing it.

Actions.Title: Remove graphic instance
Actions.Description: Remove a hidden native graphic instance.

Actions.Title: Clear native graphic instances
Actions.Description: Cancel pending native instance reveals and hide their Program layers.

Params.Name: request
Params.Description: Versioned JSON graphics request; explicit channel all

Actions.Title: Import graphics template
Actions.Description: Queue bounded native validation. Read templateInstalls for completion; admission is not installation.

Params.Name: request
Params.Description: Versioned JSON request with a manifest string or a local packagePath archive

Actions.Title: Remove graphics template version
Actions.Description: Remove one installed non-built-in template version no instance uses. Built-ins and in-use versions are refused.

Params.Name: request
Params.Description: Versioned JSON graphics request with templateId and templateVersion

Actions.Title: Observe graphics templates
Actions.Description: Read the native versioned catalog and import results without changing graphics.

Actions.Title: Select private graphics template
Actions.Description: Browse an installed template without creating a cue or changing Program.

Actions.Title: Create hidden graphics cue
Actions.Description: Create and select a hidden cue from an installed template and its current private draft. Does not Show.

Actions.Title: Assign lower third to Studio
Actions.Description: Pin the current private lower-third draft for the next Studio Show.

Actions.Title: Import local graphics image
Actions.Description: Verify a PNG/JPEG and browse it privately as a full-canvas graphic. Does not create a cue or show it.

Actions.Title: Upload graphic logo
Actions.Description: Verify a PNG/JPEG and apply it to the selected private logo draft. Does not Cue, Show or Update Program.

Actions.Title: Select graphics cue
Actions.Description: Select an existing cue for private editing.

Actions.Title: Apply graphics cue action
Actions.Description: Use the selected workspace cue: cue, show, hide, or update. Each is explicit.

Actions.Title: Save graphics cue
Actions.Description: Save the selected private cue with pinned template and image references.

Actions.Title: Restore saved graphics cue
Actions.Description: Restore an unbound saved cue hidden; Cue and Show remain explicit.

Actions.Title: List graphics playlist
Actions.Description: Read the playlist rows and the guest entries bound to Show Inputs. Changes nothing; reply carries data.

Actions.Title: Save graphics playlist row
Actions.Description: Add or replace one playlist row from its JSON (id, kind, name, hotkey, playOutAfterMs, templateId, templateVersion, fields, style, followSources, showClock). Program and Preview are unchanged.

Params.Name: rowJson
Params.Description: JSON object of one playlist row

Actions.Title: Playlist clock transport
Actions.Description: Start, pause, resume or reset the countdown of a clock playlist row's instance without showing or hiding it. Refused until the row is cued or shown.

Actions.Title: Remove graphics playlist row
Actions.Description: Remove one playlist row by id. An instance it already put on air stays until Play Out.

Actions.Title: Set graphics hotkey
Actions.Description: Assign F1..F12 to a playlist row (blank clears). A key already on another row moves to this one.

Actions.Title: Install default graphics playlist
Actions.Description: Install the five starter rows (guest, title, logo, LIVE bug, sponsor) when no playlist exists. Refused when one exists.

Params.Name: starterId
Params.Description: Show starter id; default is the first starter

Actions.Title: Play In graphic
Actions.Description: Take a playlist row to Program: create or refresh its native instance, cue it, show from the cue. Guest rows take sourceId (zoom:/capture:/media:) or default to the current Program subject.

Params.Name: sourceId
Params.Description: Guest rows: bound source id; blank = current Program subject

Actions.Title: Graphic to Preview
Actions.Description: Cue a playlist row to Preview; it rides the next Take. Guest rows take sourceId or default to the current Program subject.

Params.Name: sourceId
Params.Description: Guest rows: bound source id; blank = current Program subject

Actions.Title: Play Out graphic
Actions.Description: Hide one graphic on Program: by rowId (+sourceId for a guest entry) or by instanceId. Refused when it is not on Program.

Actions.Title: Remove graphic from Preview
Actions.Description: Drop one cued graphic from Preview without touching Program.

Actions.Title: Play Out all graphics
Actions.Description: Hide every native graphic instance on Program (playlist, design and automatic alike).

Actions.Title: Clear graphics Preview
Actions.Description: Drop every cued graphic from Preview; Program is unchanged.

Actions.Title: Read graphics strip
Actions.Description: Read the on-air strip (onProgram, onPreview, auto, automationMode, automationArmed) from native instance truth. Changes nothing; reply carries data.

Actions.Title: List shot layouts
Actions.Description: Read the shot layouts (id, name, sceneId, rowIds, hotkey, playOutOthers) and the scenes they may use. Changes nothing; reply carries data.

Actions.Title: Save shot layout
Actions.Description: Add or replace one shot layout from its JSON (id, name, sceneId or blank, rowIds, hotkey Shift+F1..Shift+F11 or blank, playOutOthers). Refused when its scene or a row does not exist. A hotkey held by another layout moves here. Program and Preview are unchanged.

Params.Name: layoutJson
Params.Description: JSON object of one shot layout

Actions.Title: Remove shot layout
Actions.Description: Remove one shot layout by id. Program and Preview are unchanged.

Actions.Title: Cue shot layout
Actions.Description: Select the layout's scene to Preview and cue its playlist rows to Preview, so the next Take carries the picture and the graphics. PlayOutOthers layouts also play out Program graphics the layout does not carry. Refused whole when the scene or a row is missing.

Actions.Title: Cue and Take shot layout
Actions.Description: graphics.layout.cue followed by the ordinary Take. A layout with no scene and no rows (Clean) only plays out.

Actions.Title: Zoom audio mode
Actions.Description: Choose independently routed ISO stems or Zoom's combined fallback mix.

Actions.Title: Audio monitor
Actions.Description: Enable/disable the audio monitor.

Actions.Title: Program buffer depth
Actions.Description: Save 2 or 3 frames for the next app launch. Does not change the running buffer. Read saved/session/restart state from /state.

Params.Name: frames
Params.Description: Exactly 2 or 3; fractional values are rejected.

Actions.Title: Monitor volume
Actions.Description: Set the audio monitor volume (0.0-1.0).

Actions.Title: Audio crosspoint
Actions.Description: Set one source-to-bus route at an expected core revision. Read audioRouteAuthorityEpoch and audioRouteRevision from /state.

Actions.Title: Master limiter
Actions.Description: Enable/disable the master limiter.

Actions.Title: Mastering
Actions.Description: Enable/disable the master-bus mastering chain.

Actions.Title: Mastering target
Actions.Description: Set the mastering loudness target (0=-14 streaming, 1=-16 podcast, 2=-23 broadcast).

Actions.Title: Scan VST3 plug-ins
Actions.Description: Scan and validate installed VST3 plug-ins in isolated host processes.

Actions.Title: Multiview layout
Actions.Description: Set the multiview layout mode.

Actions.Title: Multiview tiles
Actions.Description: Set the multiview source tile count.

Actions.Title: Multiview labels
Actions.Description: Toggle multiview labels.

Actions.Title: Multiview tally
Actions.Description: Toggle multiview tally borders.

Actions.Title: Multiview meters
Actions.Description: Toggle multiview audio meters.

Actions.Title: Multiview clock
Actions.Description: Toggle the multiview clock.

Actions.Title: Auto-assign inputs
Actions.Description: Toggle auto-assigning roster participants to Show Inputs.

Actions.Title: Auto lower-thirds
Actions.Description: Toggle automation lower-thirds.

Actions.Title: Auto captions (unavailable)
Actions.Description: Legacy compatibility: automatic captions are unavailable. Enabling is rejected; false is a no-op.

Actions.Title: Add browser source
Actions.Description: Add a render-only browser source (WebView2 host process).

Actions.Title: Remove browser source
Actions.Description: Remove a browser source by id.

Actions.Title: Reload browser source
Actions.Description: Reload a browser source's page by id.

Actions.Title: Restart show engine
Actions.Description: Restart the OHG show engine subprocess (used after it gives up, or after a config change).
